Good game. Fast paced and rewarding. Doesn't take long to figure things out. Takes up little storage. Runs fine and has enough gameplay variety to last you a while. Is early access so gotta keep that in mind if you feel like content is missing, because it's on the way. But so far it's definitely worth the asking price I think. Music is also pretty good. A bit dynamic and I think it fits the pacing and aesthetic of the game very well. Only note to the devs is maybe make melee a little more viable against bosses like Billy Boom just ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ exploding if you hit him too much or Dr Turret having a literal ring of damage around him if you get near. Most of the bosses are fun besides the bowling ball guy I've only fought him twice and won one time, lost the other, and neither time did it feel fun. That boss is a chore because you just have to jump over and over and dodge everything for so long and with so much happening at once that it's nearly impossible to not take damage during that combo of ground waves, explosions, and laser arrays coming at you all at once. The Sir Caterpillar is pretty fun and the final boss (so far) isn't too bad. Just the bowling ball guy that's a bit touchy and unbalanced and melee needs a tiny buff but otherwise I like the game. Shotguns are reliable and Commando is nuts once you unlock him, Shorty puts in massive work and the Rocket is great for turrets far away from you while you shotgun things up close. Fun game, would recommend if you like Titanfall 2 levels of mobility and precision with a Gunfire: Reborn weapon drop system but more fun options for weapons and affixes and just more variety than Gunfire in my opinion. Runs aren't too long and "beating" the game only took me 39 minutes on my first successful run with a score of A so that should tell you the learning curve isn't too steep cuz I only have a few hours into this game. Basically, it's worth playing for a shooter roguelike. Probably the best one I've played besides Risk of Rain but they're different style games so I wouldn't compare them too much. My biggest tip is learn to move with the dash and maybe even rebind it if you need to for easier access because the slide dash is the strongest tool you have besides your guns. Movement is key in this game so that's why I compared it to Titanfall 2 because the slide dodge and slide hopping is your best tool to stay alive. If your movement is bad, you're not gonna get far. But the movement is pretty satisfying so it's worth it to get good at it.

thanks for taking away all the wrenches ive earned in the 20+ hours i played in early access. wish i wouldnt have supported this game and just waited until the full release. i get putting all the characters behind unlockables but ALL my base upgrades????? really?????? the early game in this is some of the worst ive played in rogulikes and it was always nice having the option to reupgrade my base after updates they helped so much.thanks for forcing a worst experience on your vet players.

Played at least 20 hours on the Xbox App version and beat the game a few times. Now, I bought it on steam to play it AGAIN and also support the developers in this amazing game! I love the art style and the fast pace gun play, the robots abilities, literally everything. I do wish that they would expand on more robos to choose from and to make it where multiplayer is a lobby type thing. Other than that, I'll keep putting hours and hours into this game! HIGHLY RECOMMEND if you like rouge like games!
